ftp.title: FTP
ftp.body: FTP is the most power you can hold for about an hour. Power zones, IF, TSS and ride load are worked out from it.
ftp.label: FTP (watts)
ftp.hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} W. Leave it empty if you do not know it.
ftp.invalid: FTP must be between {{min}} and {{max}} W.
ftp.unset: FTP is not set, so power zones, IF and TSS are not calculated.
ftp.tip: Do not know your FTP? After a hard 20 minute ride, the ride detail suggests a number and you just tap Use.

zones.title: Power zones
zones.body: The seven Coggan zones from an FTP of {{ftp}} W.
zones.empty: Enter your FTP to see your power zone limits.

weight.title: Body weight
weight.body: W/kg uses the weight in your profile ({{kg}} kg).

ebike.label: Electric bike (e-bike)
ebike.hint: Used for the activity type on Strava (EBikeRide).

summary.explain: Speed (timer) uses the device timer, moving speed leaves out long stops, and overall uses the total time. Max speed is the fastest 3 second average. Average cadence leaves out the seconds you were coasting (0 rpm), like Garmin does.

speedEstimate: This ride has no wheel sensor or GPS, so speed and distance are estimated from power and can be off.

splits.a11yRow: Split to kilometre {{km}}, {{speed}} kilometres per hour
splits.a11yHint: Moves the marker on the charts and the map
splits.note: Each split's speed uses the moving time.

climbs.title: Climb {{n}}
climbs.a11yRow: Climb {{n}}, {{length}} kilometres, {{gain}} metres up, average grade {{grade}} percent
climbs.a11yHint: Moves the marker to the start of the climb
climbs.note: Climbs are at least 500 m long with an average grade of 3% or more, found in the elevation profile. Categories follow the Garmin ClimbPro score: length (m) times grade (%). VAM is metres climbed per hour.

power.balanceA11y: Pedal balance: left {{left}} percent, right {{right}} percent
power.noFtp: FTP is not set, so IF, TSS and power zones are not calculated yet.
power.explain: NP (Normalized Power) is the power that would cost you the same if you rode steady: a ride that surges counts as harder than its average power. IF = NP divided by FTP. TSS = hours ridden times IF squared times 100, so one hour right at FTP is 100. VI = NP divided by average power; the closer to 1.00, the steadier your pedalling. W/kg uses the weight in your profile.

powerZones.note: The seven Coggan zones from your FTP. Coasting seconds count in zone 1.

curve.a11y: Best power curve for each duration, from 1 second to {{max}}
curve.none: This ride is too short for a power curve.
curve.note: The best average power for each duration in this ride. The dashed line is your best from the rides stored in JoyoFit.

ftpSuggestion.body: Estimated FTP is 95% of your best 20 minutes ({{best}} W).
ftpSuggestion.hint: This is only a suggestion. Your FTP does not change until you tap Use.

cadence.note: Time in each cadence band. Coasting is moving with zero cadence; average cadence leaves it out.

hr.good: Under 5%: a good aerobic base, your heart rate stayed steady for the same effort.
hr.drift: Over 5%: your heart rate rose for the same effort, a sign of fatigue, heat or too little drink.
hr.better: Efficiency was better in the second half, usually after a long warm-up.
hr.explainPower: Pw:Hr compares NP with heart rate in the first and second half of the ride (after a 10 minute warm-up). The percentage is the drop in efficiency: under 5% means a good aerobic base, more than that and the heart rate drifted up.
hr.explainSpeed: Pa:Hr compares speed with heart rate in the first and second half of the ride (after a 10 minute warm-up). The percentage is the drop in efficiency: under 5% means a good aerobic base, more than that and the heart rate drifted up.

load.explainTss: A ride with power and an FTP is scored from TSS: 100 TSS (an hour at FTP) equals 240 TRIMP, the same scale as runs and other workouts. The last 7 days add up to this ride; the weekly average is the average of the 28 days before.
load.explainHr: Without power or an FTP, the ride is scored from the minutes in each heart rate zone (Edwards TRIMP). Set your FTP in Cycling settings for a load from power. The last 7 days add up to this ride; the weekly average is the average of the 28 days before.

verdictText.steady: In line with your usual week.
verdictText.spike: A big jump from your usual week. Mix in some easy days.
